expected_behavior: Treats the target as a pull request directly rather than assuming it needs an issue

Searches for an issue the PR implements using closing references, issue numbers and URLs in the title/body/branch/commits/review comments, and the issue timeline, in that order, before concluding none exists
Does not conclude 'no issue' merely because the PR body does not mention one

When no issue is found, continues from the PR alone and explicitly confirms the inferred intent with the user via ask_user before writing verification cases, rather than silently treating the PR description as confirmed intent
Does not use an uncommitted or local-only diff as the source for the plan, even if the local checkout is on a different branch
Presents the proposed testing scope, including which parts are inferred rather than confirmed, before selecting forms or writing cases
Asks the collaboration question before proceeding to delivery-path-specific steps
Builds journeyCheck entries with a 'verified' or 'source-mapped' status backed by cited sources, never claiming a route is tested in preprod without a browser observation
Runs bin/forms-api/form-flow.mjs with each case's fills until it reports no errors, and writes fill steps in its route order so no field is filled before its controlling field or while hidden
Includes a short coverage section naming what the cases do not test and why, separate from functionality explicitly outside the PR
